about: Portland Legal Group works from East Burnside Street, names three attorneys and publishes in Spanish. Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 572 reviews, the largest five-star count in this market.
Contingency fees and a free consultation, published. No case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: 1 of the firm's attorneys share a surname with a disciplined attorney, and for James Corcoran 1 of 1 decision(s) naming this surname have no searchable text, so they can be neither tied to nor ruled out against this attorney. The decisions that cannot be read are scans without searchable text, so this is a limit of the published record. Nothing here says the firm's attorney is that person.

G3.source: Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State
G3.evidence: PORTLAND LEGAL GROUP LLC is registered with the Oregon Secretary of State, under number 189131999, since 2021-11-09, and 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 572 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2020-11-08, so it has been operating for more than a year

json_ld_descriptions: Portland Legal Group offers a customer-centered, diplomatic approach to legal cases. We help our clients navigate challenging legal situations by representing their interests. If you or your loved one have sustained injuries in an accident caused by another person's negligence, our personal injury attorneys are ready to help you. We represent individuals, families, entrepreneurs, and large and small business owners throughout Oregon. Our services are aimed at helping victims of accidents caused by negligence or carelessness.
